a-bag-that-travels:p1.text: The library door was behind you now. Nib’s courier bag swung gently against his scarf. Its strap wore the soft pad from your first delivery adventure. Inside, three invitations rested in three separate pockets. Reed Hut, the Mill, and Fern Lodge were still waiting for their letters.

a-bag-that-travels:p2.text: “A dependable bag,” Nib declared proudly. He inspected the doorway tag once more, although the doorway was already far away.

a-bag-that-travels:p3.text: “And a whole woodland ahead,” Lark replied brightly. She opened the route book on a flat stone. Its first direction named the fork beneath the ferns. You followed a dry path, with the bag between your friends.

two-important-posts:p1.text: At the fork stood two wooden posts. One held a carved fish, with a splendid fin rising from its back. The other carried a small wooden fan. Four broad blades turned whenever the breeze slipped between the trees.
